name: Sentura Audit
description: Enterprise audit logging — captures tool calls, approvals, config changes, session events, and message activity for compliance and observability.

logDir.description: Directory for audit log files. Defaults to ~/.openclaw/sentura-audit/

maxAgeDays.description: Maximum age in days before log rotation

maxSizeMb.description: Maximum total log size in MB before rotation

enabled.description: Redact sensitive fields (API keys, tokens, passwords) from audit logs

patterns.description: Additional regex patterns for sensitive field names to redact

verbose.description: Include full tool arguments and results in audit entries (caution: may contain sensitive data)

defaultDataTier.description: Default data classification tier for events whose type does not have an explicit mapping (T0=public, T1=internal, T2=confidential, T3=restricted/PII, T4=secret/credentials).
